name: Scientific Chart Dashboard
summary: Interactive scientific chart CodeComponent using the Plotly extension library. Features a Plotly scatter plot with hover tooltips and lasso selection, a heatmap showing a correlation matrix across 4 numeric variables, and a 3D surface plot. Tabs switch between Scatter, Heatmap, and 3D Surface views. Select dropdowns for X and Y axis variable selection. Uses useHandler pattern for loading datasets, useAppState for chart configuration (axis selection, chart type), useTheme for Plotly layout colors, and toast on data export. Demo data: 50 data points with temperature, pressure, humidity, and wind speed variables.
shortSummary: Plotly scatter, heatmap, and 3D surface charts with axis selection and data export
